in_pashto.name: هشام

He was known for his generosity and was given the title 'As-Sallam' which means 'The Peaceful'. He was among the ten companions who were given the title 'Ashraf Al-Ansar' (The Noble Ansar).

Hesham ibn Abdul Malik was an Umayyad Caliph who ruled from 724 to 743 AD. He is known for his significant contributions to art, literature and architecture during the Umayyad period. He is also remembered for the construction of the Dome of the Rock in Jerusalem which is considered a masterpiece of Islamic architecture.
